subject: Okta pre-renewal: device posture evidence handoff & split-billing ask
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Okta pre-renewal: device posture evidence handoff & split-billing ask

Grace / Karthik —

We have the Okta renewal coming up in July and Markus at Okta sent an updated amendment that includes the device-posture add-on. Procurement asked us to: 1) validate the minimal evidence Okta will accept for our device posture profile, and 2) confirm whether we can split billing across two cost centers (SecOps vs Platform).

Grace: can you review the attached evidence checklist from Okta and mark any gaps by EOD Wednesday? I've attached the sheet Markus sent.

Karthik: procurement (procureco) will need the billing split template filled and signed. If we can confirm the account mapping, I'll coordinate the PO flow.

I attached: device_posture_evidence_sheet.xlsx (OKTA-provided template) and a blank split_billing_template.csv.

Short timeline: we promised the customer (Okta account team) confirmation this week to keep the July 1 amendment effective date. If we can't meet that, they may push pricing or require additional guardrails.

Next actions:
- Grace: gap review (EOD Wed 2027-05-19)
- Karthik: confirm cost-center codes and whether Finance will approve split invoicing (aim EOD Thu 2027-05-20)
- I'll loop procurement and Okta once we have the gaps + cost-center mapping.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0118

(attachment: device_posture_evidence_sheet.xlsx) (attachment: split_billing_template.csv)

From: Markus Vogel <markus.vogel@okta.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@okta.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta pre-renewal: device posture evidence handoff & split-billing ask

Ben / Grace —

Thanks for the quick note. Attaching the amendment (okta_amendment_v2.pdf) and a short FAQ on acceptable evidence for device posture. High level: Okta accepts either
- Endpoint management proof (MDM enrollment + policy snapshot), or
- Network posture proof (ZTNA logs + device health API output)

If you can provide the device posture evidence sheet filled with the 'current state' column populated, our contracts team can accept that as part of the amendment. Regarding split billing: we do support split invoicing for enterprise customers but need a signed billing allocation table and PO details.

If you want, Sofia and I can join a 30-minute call with procurement to walk through the billing template — we have availability tomorrow 10:00–11:30am PT.

Best,
Markus Vogel
Account Executive | Okta
markus.vogel@okta.com | +1 650-555-2244

(attachment: okta_amendment_v2.pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta pre-renewal: device posture evidence handoff & split-billing ask

Ben —

I reviewed the Okta evidence sheet. Quick summary of gaps:

1) MDM enrollment snapshot — we can provide current enrollment percentage per OS, but we don't have a historical enrollment timeline in the exact CSV shape Okta requests.
2) Policy export — we can export the device posture policy; I'll include a redacted policy dump showing the enforcement rules.
3) Agent health API output — we have the health output, but it's behind an internal endpoint; Ops needs to whitelist Okta for direct collection, which we prefer not to do. Instead, I recommend a static export (sample of 1,000 devices) and a signed attestation from Platform that the export is representative.

I'll populate the 'current state' column in device_posture_evidence_sheet.xlsx and add comments in-line.

Two asks:
- Ben: can you run the split_billing_template by Finance/Procurement and confirm account codes?
- Ben / Karthik: if procurement wants a whitelist, Platform will only allow an S3 push of the exported payload to a presigned bucket for the vendor (audit-friendly).

I'll be offline tomorrow morning but will finalize the sheet by EOD Thu.

Grace O'Connor
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

(attachment: device_posture_evidence_sheet_filled.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Tran <leah.tran@procureco.com>, Markus Vogel <markus.vogel@okta.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Okta pre-renewal: device posture evidence handoff & split-billing ask

Looping procurement and Okta as requested.

Leah (ProcureCo) — we propose the following split: 60% charged to Cost Center 4301 (Security) and 40% to Cost Center 2203 (Platform). Attached is a filled split_billing_template.csv with company/legal names and PO reference that Finance needs to accept split invoicing.

Procurement note: Finance requires the vendor to generate two invoice lines on the same invoice (not two separate invoices) or provide a consolidated invoice with internal allocation tags. Markus / Okta — can you confirm if the billing system can accept allocation tags as a single invoice with two accounting lines? If not, we need to route this through our AP with a short memo.

Ben — if Okta confirms allocation tags, I will push the PO through and sign off on the amendment. Grace's evidence sheet looks good from a security point of view; we'll attach the attestation language to the SOW.

Next steps:
- Markus / Sofia: confirm billing format (allocation tags vs separate lines) by EOD Fri 2027-05-21
- Leah / ProcureCo: review split_billing_template.csv and provide any additional PO requirements
- Ben: prep the DocuSign envelope if Okta confirms the format

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

(attachment: split_billing_template.csv)
